title: Upstart Announces $1.5B Forward-Flow Agreement with Castlelake
summary: Upstart announced today a forward-flow commitment from funds managed by Castlelake, L.P.
body_markdown: Upstart NMLS No. 936133.[NMLS Consumer Access](https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/) The information on this website does not constitute an offer to sell securities or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities.
